# P2a code quality review: third-round candidate

Verdict: **PASS for source-only review**. No additional product-source fix is
required by this review. This is not a runtime Clippy or task-completion pass.

The previous remote-derive shadowing defect is fixed by explicit `Deserialize`
trait dispatch in both callbacks. It now uses the existing object-only wrappers
for nested getter observations and captured results. The explicit generic bound
and native serialization pattern remain consistent with this crate.

The 28 previous test expectations remain. Failure-pointer diagnostics were
strengthened, and two supplemental regressions add coverage for nullable/bool
observation arrays and unavailable failure payload arrays. The suite now declares
30 tests, with no ignored tests. I did not execute them.

Rust validates raw identity and freshness using the existing error and capture
types. It preserves catalogue order and makes no naming, facet or UI policy
claim. No new dependency, unsafe code, warning suppression or production panic
path was found. The workspace permits style lints; I found no concrete issue with
its denied correctness or disallowed-method rules.

All six full supplementary source files match their recorded byte sizes and
SHA-256 hashes, preserve original Apache headers, and retain NOTICE and license
files. They do not receive original reference-test credit.

Normal tests, library build, repository Clippy, formatting, actual Gradle timing
and SDK captures remain runtime gates. The draft report and parity sidecar must
be updated with actual results before handoff; their currently pending fields
are not evidence of completed validation. Root retains full-app, full-CI and
native review gates. No compiler, Cargo, Clippy, JVM, Gradle, SDK, native process,
source or runtime-cache mutation was performed by this reviewer.

Exact reviewed file hashes and scope are in the companion JSON.
